items.text: Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks ruled OUT for MNF vs Cowboys.
items.implication: Boosts remaining Eagles pass catchers/Goedert; Saquon even more central if active.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle/high ankle sprain) downgraded to OUT for Week 7 vs Bengals; Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: High ankle sprain confirmed; missed prior two games.
items.implication: Huntley start; downgrade Ravens pass catchers/Henry slightly, boost Bengals defense/Chase.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (calf) listed QUESTIONABLE; will test pregame after limited/missing practice. McVay: felt lack of power/explosion.
items.implication: If OUT, heavy TE usage (Higbee lead) and other WRs.

items.text: Key OUTs: Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, Davante Adams, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Zach Charbonnet, Brian Robinson. INs: Josh Jacobs, Quinshon Judkins, Jordan Addison, TJ Hockenson.
items.implication: Beneficiaries in those backfields/receiving corps (e.g. Judkins full, Addison boost).

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs activated from exempt list and expected to play Sunday.
items.implication: Workload TBD post-layoff; Berry hates due to questions.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley questionable but expected to play MNF vs Cowboys; DeVonta OUT.
items.implication: Start if active vs soft DAL run D.

items.text: Breece Hall Q; Stephania worried on immediate return but Berry starts him if active vs MIA.
If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell etc.
items.implication: Higbee lead TE target; multi-TE sets.

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK (w/ Caleb): 30% TS, 19.2 PPR/g, 6+ rec and 60+ yds both games.
Falcons RB Brian Robinson Jr (hamstring) OUT; 49ers D inflates opposing RB production (4.4% above baseline). Sweet setup for Bijan Robinson full workload.
items.why: Listed OUT; recent RB catches vs SF.
items.implication: Bijan bellcow upgrade vs soft SF.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts (scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt: Evans/Deebo OUT). CMC tempted for more slot with WR injuries (Black present); rarely buy RB-as-WR but this dire.
items.why: WR injuries create funnel; CMC smile on slot question.
items.implication: Kittle elite TE1; CMC receiving upside.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (usage/role back); also Kraft @ DET (TE buffet D), Jaylen Warren @ NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @ CAR. Hates Rome Odunze vs NE, Josh Downs @ MIN, Travis Kelce @ SEA, Josh Jacobs (layoff workload).
items.why: Matchups/usage for loves; tough spots/roles for hates. Saquon if active also love.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% snaps over last three weeks. Downgrade.
Luther Burden only 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR. Kmet injury may reduce 2/3-sets, giving Burden more juice.
